title: Prune a run's WIP snapshot refs on origin when the tick closes
description: From #68: evacuation and wall-clock snapshots are pushed to refs/ticfac/wip/<run>/tick-<t>/attempt-<n> on origin and never pruned there (PurgeState deletes only the local ref). Delete them on origin when the tick closes, as the close retires the attempt branch.
acceptance_criteria: After a tick closes, origin carries none of its WIP refs; a test asserts it
closed_reason: The leftover sweep retires a closed tick's wip refs locally and on origin; failures are recorded with their remote class and retried by the next sweep; an open tick keeps them. The sweep also skips a worktree whose local-executor attempt has a live supervisor or runner pid. Tests in internal/reconcile/sweep_test.go.
